title: pvExtractSelection
body:
## pvExtractSelection

Extracts the points or cells described by a selection (Selection port, from one of the pv*SelectionSource operations or pvConvertSelection) from Input. By default the result is an unstructured grid holding only the selected elements (a table of selected rows for table input); with PreserveTopology it is a copy of the input with a vtkInsidedness array marking selected elements. Use it to isolate cells by ID, value, threshold, location, frustum or query.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The selection's field type (CELL or POINT on the source) decides whether cells or points are extracted; a POINT selection without ContainingCells yields vertices only.
- Selections built from IDs refer to the indices of the dataset they were made for; connect the same upstream data that the IDs came from.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractSelection`. Identity: `filters/ExtractSelection`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input from which the selection is extracted. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkTable","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `Selection` | Required data input for the native Selection port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input that provides the selection object. Accepted data: selections (vtkSelection). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkSelection"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `HyperTreeGridToUnstructuredGrid` | Output an unstructured grid instead of a hyper tree grid (for input hyper tree grids). Should not be changed after first execution. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PreserveTopology` | If this property is set to 1 the output preserves the topology of its input and adds an insidedness array to mark which cells are inside or out. If 0 then the output is an unstructured grid which contains only the subset of cells that are inside. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvExtractSelection",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input",
    "Selection": "UPSTREAM_Selection"
  }
}
```
